description: Native Enyo 32-bucket input-factorizer Bullet/SF-binpack smoke. This tests shared (piece,square) representation learning folded into the exported 32-bucket runtime net.

metadata.hypothesis: Previous native scratch runs likely starved bucket-specific input features. A shared train-time input factorizer gives every king bucket a common (piece,square) representation while still exporting an ordinary Enyo 32-bucket .nn with zero runtime format change. This is the smallest export-visible architecture change that directly targets data starvation.
constraints: CP-only objective; no WDL on test79
factorizer is folded into exported l0w; engine runtime remains unchanged
checkpoint gate before any continuation or SPRT

validation.first_gate: checkpoint sweep at 512 and 1024 on the 800-target Lichess-policy gate, reusing the cached reference CSV.
validation.continue_only_if: At least one checkpoint materially beats the old true-32 smoke and does not retain catastrophic mate-like tails.
validation.promotion: No SPRT unless checkpoint gate and failure-suite replay are clean.
